name: Coupé Summer Programs
description_short: Summer dance programs at Coupé Theatre Studio in Nanuet: Coupé Kids mornings for ages 3 to 6, two week Ballet and All Styles intensives for older dancers with a performance and a Broadway or Lincoln Center trip, and one week all styles camps for ages 7 to 18. Families can dance for 1 to 6 weeks between June 29 and August 7.

sessions.name: Coupé Kids Session I (ages 3 to 6, 9:30 to 12:30)
Coupé Kids Session V (extended day option for ages 5 and 6)
Coupé Kids Session VI (extended day option for ages 5 and 6)
Ballet or All Styles Intensive Session I (10 to 4)
Ballet or All Styles Intensive Session II (10 to 4)
One Week All Styles Dance Camp, week 1 (ages 7 to 18)
One Week All Styles Dance Camp, week 2 (ages 7 to 18)

notes: 2026 prices for registration after April 1 (earlier registration was cheaper). Coupé Kids 9:30 to 12:30: 1 week $350 up to 6 weeks $1,720; extended day to 2:30 for ages 5 and 6 (sessions V and VI) $575 a week or $985 for both. Ballet Intensive (age 9 and up, teacher recommendation) and All Styles Intensive: $1,555 a session, $3,025 for both sessions, or a 10 to 2:30 single week $595. One week camps $750 a week or $1,355 both. A $100 deposit goes toward tuition. The summer page gives One Week camp dates as July 24 to 31 and the tuition page as July 27 to August 7; the session dates used are July 27 to 31 and August 3 to 7. The intensives page gives ages only as 9 and up for Ballet; the summer page says 7 to 18 for All Styles.
